description: Follows Tayo’s return from war and search for healing, connecting story, land, community, racial violence, and forms of historical memory. Covers What would it mean for a story to help someone live?; The form refuses to put the past behind the present; Mixed ancestry and the lie of purity; The story told back to its listeners.
